name: ios-build-optimization
description: Diagnose and optimize build times and module architecture for large iOS apps (Swift / SwiftPM / Xcode).

interface.shortDescription: Evidence-gated iOS build time and module design review
interface.longDescription: Diagnose slow Xcode builds from Build Timeline data, evaluate Target/Package/linkage decisions against the measured dependency graph, and emit evidence-labeled proposals (FACT/INFERENCE/HYPOTHESIS/MEASURED) with measurement plans instead of unmeasured assertions.
defaultPrompt: iOS アプリのビルドが遅いので診断して
モジュール分割をビルド性能の観点で評価して
Build Timeline を見てボトルネックを分類して
